info.title: devorch
info.description: Dev Orchestrator CLI (devorch): a .NET tool driven by the API's OpenAPI document, over the Kiota-generated SDK.

commands.name: answer

commands.name: companion
commands.description: The Claude Code companion plugin: the DevOrch skills, the step worker, an MCP server, and the mod that wakes an idle /devorch-companion:devorch-step session on run events.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Prepare the Claude Code companion mod shipped with this CLI: record this executable in the mod folder and print the `claude plugin marketplace add` / `claude plugin install` commands. Exit 66 when this build carries no claude-mod folder.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: The companion plugin's MCP server: `devorch mcp serve` over stdio, with the base URL resolved through the DevOrch settings files (`devorch config get apiBase --show-origin` shows the same value). Run by the plugin's .mcp.json; sign in first with `devorch login --oauth --base-url <url>`.

options.name: --oauth
options.description: Sign in through the browser (OAuth + PKCE via the API's identity provider, e.g. WorkOS AuthKit). Use this for SSO / social accounts.

options.name: --token
options.description: Cache a static bearer, normally a Personal Access Token from /app/account/tokens. Pass `-` to read it from stdin (keeps it out of shell history).

options.description: --oauth: print the sign-in URL instead of opening a browser.

options.name: --port
options.description: --oauth: loopback port for the redirect (default: the cached client's port, else any free port).

options.name: --timeout
options.description: --oauth: minutes to wait for the browser sign-in. (Default: 5)

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the MCP server. Default: stdio + full profile (reads + execution-writes + driver-control + interactive, e.g. answer_blocker). --profile run-agent: subtractive minimal (Read + Execution only). --profile driver: + driver-control loop verbs. --allow-admin (alias --allow-control): + the admin band: mutate/control pipeline verbs, type CRUD, attach_document (full only). --explore: + generic entity tools (full only). --http: remote Streamable-HTTP.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: API base URL (default: the resolved apiBase setting; see `devorch config get apiBase --show-origin`).

options.name: --allow-admin
options.description: Also expose the admin band (full profile only): the mutate/control pipeline verbs (set_step_status, waive_blocker, ...), type CRUD and attach_document. Off by default. Reads, execution-writes and (full profile) the interactive band, e.g. answer_blocker, are on regardless of this flag.

options.name: --allow-control
options.description: Deprecated back-compat alias for --allow-admin (the old binary control gate). Prefer --allow-admin.

options.name: --explore
options.description: Also expose the generic entity 'explore' tools (list_resources/get_resource/list_types/get_type). Off by default — not the run agent's loadout.

options.name: --http
options.description: Serve over remote Streamable-HTTP instead of stdio (each request authenticates with its own bearer).

options.name: --profile
options.description: Loadout profile: full (default — operator toolbelt incl. driver-control + interactive, e.g. answer_blocker, + flagged admin/explore), run-agent (subtractive minimal: Read + Execution only, excludes the program-counter verbs), or driver (Read + Execution + driver-control loop verbs). (Default: full)

commands.name: drive
commands.description: Drive a run: fetch typed instructions and branch on `control` (execute_step / evaluate / record_backedge). --once: one step. --fixture FILE + --dry-run: fully offline state-machine exercise. --billing api_key keeps ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (default subscription strips it). CREDENTIAL: a `devorch login` token is short-lived (~1h) and is NOT auto-refreshed - a run that outlives it exits 77 (auth). For unattended runs use a long-lived Personal Access Token (create at /app/account/tokens, save as access_token in ~/.devorch/token.json).

options.name: --base-url
options.description: API base URL (default: the resolved apiBase setting; see `devorch config get apiBase --show-origin`).

options.name: --once
options.description: Run exactly one step (same code path as the loop) and stop.

options.name: --max-steps
options.description: Hard cap on iterations (runaway guard); --once implies 1. (Default: 60)

options.name: --max-consecutive-failures
options.description: Stop after this many back-to-back failures (reset on success). (Default: 2)

options.name: --max-wait-polls
options.description: DEPRECATED (use --max-wait): stop after this many CONSECUTIVE WAIT polls. With a live backend it converts to polls x 25 s of parked time. (Default: 60)

options.name: --max-wait
options.description: Bound on total time parked on WAIT without advancing (e.g. 90m, 8h; default 8h). A WAIT parks on the server and resumes within seconds of the change.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Mock dispatch (no claude): post canned successful results.

options.name: --fixture
options.description: Replay next-instruction envelopes from a local JSON file (offline; results captured, not sent).

options.name: --billing
options.description: Billing mode: subscription (default, strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) or api_key.

options.name: --emit-bodies
options.description: (fixture) write the captured result bodies as a JSON array to this file (the conformance corpus sink).

commands.name: step
commands.description: HAND CRANK: push the program counter one step at a time, by hand, and see what the engine did with it. Prints each instruction envelope, waits for a keystroke ([Enter]=report success, f=reject the gate, b=raise a blocker, x=report a malformed result, p=peek, q=stop), then re-reads GET /position and prints the delta - the ENGINE's answer, never the tool's claim. Writes a 3-file transcript; the .canonical.json is redacted + key-sorted so two identical sessions diff to NOTHING. --script replays keys with no human (the regression gate: re-run after an engine change and diff the canonical file against the accepted one).

options.name: --base-url
options.description: API base URL (default: the resolved apiBase setting; see `devorch config get apiBase --show-origin`).

options.name: --name
options.description: Transcript base name (default: crank-<run-prefix>-<utc stamp>). Pass a FIXED name to overwrite an accepted baseline in place.

options.name: --script
options.description: Replay keys with no human: a comma/space-separated list (e.g. ",,f,,x,q" - an empty item is [Enter]) or @path to a file with one key per line.

commands.name: supervise
commands.description: Restart-safe wrapper around `run drive`: re-launch on a TRANSIENT death (backend unreachable), STOP on a LOGICAL terminal (DONE / ABORT / a real ESCALATE) or an AUTH failure (exit 77 - a re-launch cannot fix a rejected credential). CREDENTIAL: prefer a long-lived PAT (create at /app/account/tokens, save as access_token in ~/.devorch/token.json); a `devorch login` token expires in ~1h and is NOT refreshed, so any longer run will die on it.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: API base URL (default: the resolved apiBase setting; see `devorch config get apiBase --show-origin`).

options.name: --max-restarts
options.description: Max transient (backend-unreachable) re-launches before giving up (0 = one shot). (Default: 20)

options.name: --restart-backoff
options.description: Base seconds before a transient re-launch (doubles each consecutive transient death, capped). (Default: 2)

options.name: --restart-backoff-cap
options.description: Cap on the transient re-launch backoff. (Default: 30)

options.name: --max-steps
options.description: (driver) hard cap on iterations per launch.

options.name: --max-consecutive-failures
options.description: (driver) stop after this many back-to-back failures.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: (driver) mock dispatch (no claude) - lets the supervisor be mock-tested.

options.name: --fixture
options.description: (driver) replay envelopes from a local JSON file (offline).

options.name: --max-wait
options.description: (driver) bound on total time parked on WAIT (e.g. 90m, 8h; default 8h).

commands.name: wait
commands.description: One long-poll: print exactly one run.position line (the first position after --since, or the current one at timeout) and exit 0. Exit 77 auth, 66 not found, 75 transport.

options.name: --since
options.description: Return once the position differs from this token (default: return the current one).

options.name: --base-url
options.description: API base URL (default: the resolved apiBase setting; see `devorch config get apiBase --show-origin`).

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Stream the run's position as NDJSON: one run.position platform event per line, each time the position changes (a claim, an applied result, a blocker raised or answered, a lease lapse), until the run is terminal. Parks on the server (25 s per request); never claims. Runs the local hooks of the DevOrch settings files on run.terminal, blocker.raised and step.applied (once per machine; --no-hooks turns them off). Exit 0 terminal or Ctrl+C, 77 auth, 66 not found.

options.name: --since
options.description: Start after this position token (from a previous line's data.position).

options.name: --no-hooks
options.description: Do not run the local hooks from the DevOrch settings files (run.terminal, blocker.raised, step.applied).
